title: Render Window Controls in Sketchpad via Desktop Prop
description: Sketchpad does not render window controls (minimize/maximize/close). All desktop functionality must be implemented in sketchpad and passed via a single `desktop` prop. When the desktop prop is not provided, sketchpad runs in non-desktop mode. Replace the existing `onWindowEvents` prop with a `desktop` prop and render window controls at the right end of the navbar when desktop mode is active. Update compose/desktop/renderer.tsx to pass a `desktop` prop.
summary: Replaced `onWindowEvents`/`WindowEvents` with a single `desktop` prop and `Desktop` type on Sketchpad. Presence of the `desktop` prop is now the sole signal that sketchpad is running in desktop mode. Rendered minimize/maximize/close controls as a new `windowControls` navbar item (rightmost, appears only when `desktop` is set). Plumbed the prop through `SketchpadScopeProvider` and the outer `Sketchpad` component. Updated `compose/desktop/renderer.tsx` to pass `desktop` instead of `onWindowEvents`. Drag region CSS in `elements/ui/globals.css` already marks `#navbar` as drag and interactive elements as no-drag, so the new controls are clickable over the window drag area.
